subject: Post-discovery: Demo slot + capacity call for FinForge
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: Demo slot + capacity call for FinForge
Attachments: finforge-discovery-notes.pdf (summary)

Hi Ellis,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet the FinForge team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned before we lock a calendar invite:

- Discovery highlights: production ML inference for claim-parsing pipeline; bursts up to ~2,500 requests/min with 200-token average; 95th-pct latency target 150ms.
- Key goals for the next session: (1) a short demo of Redwood's routing and KV/prefix caching in a realistic flow, (2) a dedicated capacity sizing calibration (throughput/latency walk-through) with your SREs to size a reserved GPU pool.

Can we lock a 90-minute window next week for the demo + sizing run-through? Suggested slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-04-21 11:00–12:30
- Wed 2026-04-22 09:00–10:30

Please confirm which works best or propose two alternatives. Also, could you share a small sample payload (50–100 requests or a representative CSV) and an SLO doc if you have one — that will help our infra team prepare accurate throughput projections.

I attached a short discovery notes PDF and will include Ben (solutions) and Aditya (platform) on the sizing call.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Sofia —

Appreciate the recap. Tue 4/21 11:00–12:30 PDT works well for our infra folks. If something comes up, Wed 4/22 09:00–10:30 is our fallback.

I've attached a small traffic sample and our SLO summary. I've looped in Sara (SRE lead) so she can bring the upstream service constraints. We'll also invite our procurement contact separately if the conversation moves toward terms.

Two asks before the call to make the sizing concrete:
- Can Redwood share a short pre-call checklist (what metrics/fields you need in the sample)?
- Will a 90-minute slot include a short load-run or only a walk-through? If you plan a live sizing run, we'll need to agree on a test token budget.

Thanks,
Ellis
VP Product — FinForge
ellis@finforge.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Demo slot + capacity call for FinForge
Attachments: pre-call-checklist.pdf (Redwood pre-call checklist)

Ellis / Sofia —

We can run a 45–60 minute demo and then a 30–45 minute sizing calibration. For a sizing run we normally:
- Review sample payload and traffic shape (we use 1k warmup, then 10k request window in our lab unless the customer limits tokens)
- Agree test token budget and data handling (we respect redaction/PII needs)
- Capture per-token latency at P50/P95 and end-to-end request latency with KV cache enabled/disabled

I've attached the pre-call checklist — it lists the exact fields we need (timestamp, request type, avg token count, concurrency pattern). We'll hold a reserved GPU slot on Tue 11:00 if you confirm. If it looks like you need a larger pool, we can change the reservation.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0178
